resources.string: Your manual portfolio is available offline.

Add US stocks, ETFs or indices using their Twelve Data symbols. Enter your own API key, then refresh explicitly. Data access, exchange permissions, delays and quotas depend on your account plan; an ETF is not an index. Up to six instruments update per batch, prioritizing missing or older prices, with a conservative six-request local limit per minute. Saved prices remain offline with source and observation time. “Recent” means observed and retrieved within 15 minutes, not guaranteed live. Failed or empty updates retain the last saved price. Indices show points; other quotes retain their source currency. Quotes never change manual valuations, cash or net worth.
